about.description: MERVCR is a security token representing common stock in Merv Capital Ltd. (BVI), a technology-driven luxury car rental company. Deployed on Arbitrum via Stobox STV3 Protocol. Token price $10 per MERVCR. STO targeting $2M raise with minimum $1,000 investment. Investors receive monthly earnings in stablecoins tied to fleet revenue. 12-month lock-up period. 200,000 tokens minted. Max supply 200,000 (6-decimal adjusted). TVT $2.0M per Dune dashboard. Created on-chain 2026-01-06. Treasury wallet: 0x6ddbaafde80a8670d9ea6626c4adfadbb5d698b4.
